revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Added Procedure section establishing trending methods, quarterly and annual review frequency, and escalation criteria; revised the two existing objectives (lot acceptance rate to at least 90 percent rolling twelve-month; complaint rate to less than 1 percent rolling twelve-month); added three new objectives (Active Post-Market Surveillance at least 12 activities per year; Dynamic Employee Training Program at least 10 activities per year; Quarterly Execution of Quality Plan Objectives at least 80 percent on schedule). Objective values are management-aligned per the QM.SLQ037 Objectives Management Alignment Sheet. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 14; 2026 Quality Plan (Quality Objectives: revise existing and add new).
